name: soft_constraint4.k
model:
class NamedSoftConstraints {
  budget:Int
  quality:Int
  speed:Int

  req budget >= 0

  req budget <= 1000

  req quality >= 1

  req quality <= 10

  req speed >= 1

  req speed <= 10

  soft req lowCost: budget < 500

  soft req highQuality: quality >= 8

  soft req fast: speed >= 7

  req budget >= quality * 50
}

project:NamedSoftConstraints
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (project Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((NamedSoftConstraints (mk-NamedSoftConstraints (budget Int)(quality Int)(speed Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-NamedSoftConstraints (sel-NamedSoftConstraints NamedSoftConstraints))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-NamedSoftConstraints ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-NamedSoftConstraints (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-NamedSoftConstraints ((this Ref)) NamedSoftConstraints
  (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-NamedSoftConstraints ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-NamedSoftConstraints this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.project: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!project ((this Ref)) Ref
  (project (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class NamedSoftConstraints:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for NamedSoftConstraints.budget: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints!budget ((this Ref)) Int
  (budget (deref-NamedSoftConstraints this))
)

; --- getters for NamedSoftConstraints.quality: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints!quality ((this Ref)) Int
  (quality (deref-NamedSoftConstraints this))
)

; --- getters for NamedSoftConstraints.speed: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints!speed ((this Ref)) Int
  (speed (deref-NamedSoftConstraints this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-NamedSoftConstraints (TopLevelDeclarations!project this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class NamedSoftConstraints:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-NamedSoftConstraints NamedSoftConstraints)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (NamedSoftConstraints!budget this) 0)
)

(assert (! (NamedSoftConstraints.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (NamedSoftConstraints!budget this) 1000)
)

(assert (! (NamedSoftConstraints.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (NamedSoftConstraints!quality this) 1)
)

(assert (! (NamedSoftConstraints.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (NamedSoftConstraints!quality this) 10)
)

(assert (! (NamedSoftConstraints.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (NamedSoftConstraints!speed this) 1)
)

(assert (! (NamedSoftConstraints.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (NamedSoftConstraints!speed this) 10)
)

(assert (! (NamedSoftConstraints.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Soft Constraint 7: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.soft7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (NamedSoftConstraints!budget this) 500)
)

(assert-soft (NamedSoftConstraints.soft7 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft7)

; --- Soft Constraint 8: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.soft8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (NamedSoftConstraints!quality this) 8)
)

(assert-soft (NamedSoftConstraints.soft8 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft8)

; --- Soft Constraint 9: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.soft9 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (NamedSoftConstraints!speed this) 7)
)

(assert-soft (NamedSoftConstraints.soft9 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft9)

; --- Invariant 10: ---

(define-fun NamedSoftConstraints.inv10 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (NamedSoftConstraints!budget this) (* (NamedSoftConstraints!quality this) 50))
)

(assert (! (NamedSoftConstraints.inv10 1) :named _xkassert10))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-NamedSoftConstraints const-1-NamedSoftConstraints))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-NamedSoftConstraints () NamedSoftConstraints
  (mk-NamedSoftConstraints 500 10 9))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (budget (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 1000))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (>= (speed (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (project (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-NamedSoftConstraints a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (* (quality (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 50)))
  (>= (budget (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (quality (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (<= (speed (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (budget (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (quality (sel-NamedSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 10))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-NamedSoftConstraints (mk-NamedSoftConstraints 500 10 9))))
